style: who is speaking to whom, and what has just happened

candidates.angle: Arjuna calls them aggressors but says killing brings no joy
candidates.evidence: पापमेवाश्रयेदस्मान्हत्वैतानाततायिनः (killing these aggressors would only bring us sin)

candidates.angle: Arjuna names them sons of Dhritarashtra and then as aggressors
candidates.evidence: धार्तराष्ट्रान्... आततायिनः (the sons of Dhritarashtra... aggressors)

candidates.angle: Arjuna counts the cost of killing his own people
candidates.evidence: का प्रीतिः स्यात् (what joy would there be)

angle_en: Arjuna counts the cost of killing his own kin
angle_hi: अर्जुन अपने ही बंधुओं को मारने की कीमत गिनते हैं

en.intro: Arjuna has just listed his kin and teachers on the battlefield. He names the enemy, but his heart is not in it. Listen for the cost he counts.
en.notice: Arjuna calls them aggressors, yet he says killing them will bring no joy and only stain the killers with sin.
en.next: He asks again, how can we be happy after killing our own blood, O Madhava?
en.meaning: O Janardana, what joy would come to us by killing these sons of Dhritarashtra? Killing these aggressors would only bring us sin.

hi.intro: अर्जुन ने अभी अपने परिवार और गुरुओं को मैदान में देखा है। वे शत्रुओं को पहचानते हैं, पर उनका मन इसमें नहीं है। सुनिए, वे क्या कीमत गिनते हैं।
hi.meaning: हे जनार्दन, धृतराष्ट्र के पुत्रों और उनके साथियों को मारकर हमें क्या प्रसन्नता मिलेगी? ये आततायी हैं, फिर भी इन्हें मारने से हमें पाप ही लगेगा।
hi.notice: धृतराष्ट्र के पुत्रों को मारकर क्या सुख, पाप ही लगेगा
hi.next: वे फिर पूछते हैं, अपने ही बंधुओं को मारकर हम कैसे खुश हो सकते हैं, हे माधव?
